What is the function of melanin?
What gland is called the 'Master Gland'?
Name the 12 cranial nerves.
flashcards.answer: I Olfactory, II Optic, III Oculomotor, IV Trochlear, V Trigeminal, VI Abducens, VII Facial, VIII Vestibulocochlear, IX Glossopharyngeal, X Vagus, XI Accessory, XII Hypoglossal.

units.title: Nursing Care of Patients with Feeding/Elimination Problems

flashcards.question: What is Gastrostomy feeding?
flashcards.answer: Feeding directly into the stomach through an opening in the abdominal wall.

flashcards.question: Define Urinary Retention.
flashcards.answer: Inability to empty the bladder completely or at all.

units.title: Management of Clients with Respiratory System Problems

flashcards.question: What is a Tracheostomy?
flashcards.answer: Surgical creation of an opening into the trachea to provide an airway.

units.title: Management of Clients with Digestive System Problems

flashcards.question: What are common disorders of the esophagus?
Define Epidemiology.
flashcards.answer: The study of how often diseases occur in different groups of people and why.

flashcards.question: What is the Essential Drug Programme?
flashcards.answer: A policy to ensure availability of high-quality, safe, and effective drugs at affordable prices.

flashcards.question: Define Pharmacovigilance.
flashcards.answer: The science and activities relating to the detection, assessment, understanding and prevention of adverse effects.

flashcards.question: Define Reproductive Health.
flashcards.answer: A state of physical, mental, and social well-being in all matters relating to the reproductive system.

flashcards.question: Define PMTCT.
flashcards.answer: Prevention of Mother-to-Child Transmission of HIV.

flashcards.question: Define Nursing Research.
flashcards.answer: A scientific process that validates and refines existing knowledge and generates new knowledge in nursing.
